title: erigeron callianthemus var. scaposus
intro: Erigeron callianthemus var. scaposus, commonly known as the Alpine Fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Fleabane include acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory agent, and antispasmodic, which can help relieve coughs, reduce inflammation, and soothe muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
